wins: Completed automated recon sweep and identified 3 live hosts with open ports within the first episode, enabling focused targeting.
Successfully documented service versions and OS fingerprints, delivering structured input for downstream exploitation planning.
fails: Failed to escalate privileges on compromised host due to missing sudo permissions and no fallback exploitation strategy.
Repeatedly aborted after initial foothold because post-exploitation tooling was not invoked, resulting in 0% success rate despite reconnaissance.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase executed effectively, but mission failed after foothold due to lack of privilege escalation and post-exploitation follow-through.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation never attempted after initial shell access, leaving mission incomplete despite foothold.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial shell obtained but privileges remain low
skill_cards.then_action: Execute automated sudo checks and common local kernel exploit scans

skill_cards.if_condition: When multiple services enumerated on a single host
skill_cards.then_action: Chain service-specific exploits starting with highest CVSS severity

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
Needed for addressing repeated privilege escalation gaps

next_experiments.title: Implement automated privilege escalation sweep
next_experiments.description: After foothold, immediately run scripted sudo checks and local exploit suggestion tools to identify privilege escalation paths before ending episode.

next_experiments.title: Post-exploitation workflow integration
next_experiments.description: Chain post-exploitation actions (credential harvesting, persistence checks) into single workflow to ensure episode progress beyond initial shell.
